name: Weekend of Horrors
blurb: A horror-movie celebrity convention in Cologne with autographs, photo ops and a roughly 4,000 square metre dealer and cosplay hall.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Erlebe Horrorstars live auf dem Weekend of Horrors in Köln vom 24. bis 25. Oktober 2026!' and address block '24.10.2025 - 25.10.2026 Die Halle Tor 2 Girlitzweg 30 50829 Köln Germany' (the '2025' is a stray leftover in that line; the day/month/city/venue match the headline sentence, so 2026 is used)

notes: 30 star names confirmed from the homepage's running guest list, cross-checked against the 30 individual /stars/<slug>/ pages listed in page-sitemap.xml (one slug per name, e.g. /stars/malcom-mcdowell/, /stars/uwe-boll/), which also confirms the count (90 homepage guest images / 3 images-per-person = 30). Each guest card on the homepage is CSS background-image divs with no alt text or per-image name, so individual photos could not be reliably paired to specific names without guessing which of 3 unlabeled images belongs to whom; used textOnlyGuests instead so a future photo pass can fetch each confirmed /stars/<slug>/ page by name. Cover uses the top-billed guest's (Malcolm McDowell, site spells it 'Malcom') photo since the site has no og/twitter image or logo. 'Known for' left blank per the card (no bios on the page); cat is 'actor' for the identified film/TV actors and 'other' for a director (Uwe Boll) and two names (Neil Marschall, Margie Newton) whose exact role could not be confirmed from the card alone -- Neil Marschall is very likely director Neil Marshall (The Descent), spelled the German way, appearing alongside that film's star Shauna Macdonald, but this is not certain enough to assert as fact. No independent organizer name found (impressum page requires JS and was not fully readable); likely the same 'weloveconventions' group that runs Weekend of Hell, but not confirmed.
